english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physical waste, and it can also be used as a harsh noun for a worthless person or thing.
Use this as the all-purpose word for rubbish or discarded material.
This is the all-purpose choice for litter and discarded refuse.
This is the all-purpose everyday word for discarded material, rubbish, or garbage.
This is the all-purpose noun for physical rubbish and, more broadly, worthless stuff.
Use 垃圾 as the all-purpose noun for discarded rubbish and, figuratively, something worthless or poor-quality.
Use 垃圾 as the all-purpose word for waste or rubbish, especially rubbish left on the ground.
Use 垃圾 when “stuff” means refuse or worthless matter, rather than for nonsense in speech.

examples.traditional: 廚房啲垃圾好臭，快啲拎去掉啦。
